IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight dark
hair parted to one side stands against a white
backdrop. She wears a white ribbed knit
off-shoulder cardigan with a wide folded neckline
and a double zip down the front, with a chain-link
ear cuff and a silver necklace. A low-rise beige
cargo trouser sits beneath a white logo waistband.
Her expression is calm and direct, with glossy red
lips. Soft, even studio light. Palette of ivory, sand,
and silver. Sleek and minimal, in the style of a
minimalist knitwear campaign.
